additions.name: Shire of Narrogin / Dryandra tourism - parkrun
additions.scope: Selected official local tourism parkrun schedule and venue
additions.evidence: The Shire of Narrogin tourism page identifies Old Golf Course parkrun, Earl Street, Narrogin, as a free weekly 5 km on Saturdays at 08:00. Fresh direct HTTP 200 body supersedes the earlier shorter-alias timeout. No inaugural date is established.

additions.name: Roadrunner Club - Provo parkrun programme
additions.scope: Organising club parkrun launch and seasonal local start programme
additions.evidence: The organising club gives Delta Gateway Park, Provo, 5 km every Saturday, practice from 17 October and official launch on 21 November 2026. It specifies 09:00 November-April and 08:00 May-October; practice events are not official fixtures.

additions.name: Waterford Sports Partnership - parkrun
additions.scope: Local delivery partner parkrun launch, format and regular schedule
additions.evidence: The article modified 27 August 2026 announces an October Dungarvan Greenway launch and Saturday 09:30 starts at the Railway Cottage. It is a pre-launch article, so actual launch requires separate evidence. Format reference https://www.waterfordsportspartnership.ie/parkrun/ (January 2025) distinguishes Saturday 5 km and Sunday 2 km; its erroneous origin-year sentence is not reused.

additions.name: Cork Sports Partnership - parkrun programmes
additions.scope: Local delivery partner current adult parkrun list and start-time FAQ
additions.evidence: The current adult list includes Cork Harbour Greenway, Carrigaline, and identifies the 5 km format. The FAQ states 09:30 starts. This does not establish an individual cancellation check or the inaugural date.

additions.name: NSW Health Active and Healthy - parkrun listing
additions.scope: Government-hosted organiser listing for Coffs Harbour parkrun
additions.evidence: The opened listing links the exact Coffs Harbour parkrun website and organiser email and identifies Park Beach Reserve, 5 km, Saturdays at 07:00. The page has no dated schedule revision. Unrelated outdated milestone-shirt text is not reused. This is the existing Coffs Harbour event, not the new Coffs Creek event.

additions.name: City of Coffs Harbour - parkrun land licence
additions.scope: Municipal parkrun venue and land-licence context
additions.evidence: The council notice proposes licensing Coffs Creek community land to parkrun Australia for Saturday morning organised running; submissions closed 15 October 2026. This notice alone does not establish the local start time, distance or fulfilled launch conditions.

additions.name: Team Nila / Volunteer Singapore - parkrun opportunity
additions.scope: Government-hosted organiser opportunity and historical venue schedules
additions.evidence: The organiser opportunity names East Coast Park, Bishan and West Coast Park and gives free 5 km events on Saturdays at 07:30. Its volunteer shift dates are from 2019. This is historical corroboration, not a fresh 2026 local cancellation check or evidence for the other Singapore venues. The current official national 07:30 poster is separate parkrun provenance.

additions.name: South Dublin County Council - parkrun programmes
additions.scope: Municipal adult and junior parkrun programme reference
additions.evidence: Council information identifies adult Corkagh as 5 km, Saturday 09:30, and Griffeen juniors as 2 km, Sunday 09:30. It does not list the new Corkagh junior event. Do not transfer a different venue or adult schedule to an unverified junior programme.

additions.name: City of Canada Bay - Cabarita parkrun proposal
additions.scope: Municipal conditional parkrun trial approval and proposed schedule
additions.evidence: The 21 April 2026 council agenda describes a six-month Cabarita trial, 5 km on Saturdays at 08:00, from western Cabarita Park towards Breakfast Point. Launch remains contingent on fundraising. Approval and a proposed timetable do not establish that the launch conditions were met.

additions.name: Royal Botanic Gardens Kew - Wakehurst parkrun
additions.scope: Primary venue parkrun schedule, location and launch context
additions.evidence: The primary venue page gives year-round Saturday 09:00 starts and 5 km at Wakehurst. The 16 December 2025 release at https://www.kew.org/about-us/press-media/january-2026 already describes the event operating. Venue address evidence: https://www.kew.org/about-us/contact-us . The official current map key is kewwakehurst; an earlier wakehurst key must be reconciled before creating another event. A past 3 October cancellation is not a November cancellation.

additions.name: Lost Shore Surf Resort - venue events
additions.scope: Primary venue event discovery and address context
additions.evidence: The primary venue and https://www.lostshore.com/visit/getting-here/ establish Lost Shore at 11 South Platt Hill, Newbridge, EH28 8AY, near Ratho. No explicit local parkrun timetable was found. This is venue context only; it does not verify a distance, start time or first date.

additions.name: Norfolk Food Hall - parkrun programme
additions.scope: Primary venue weekly parkrun schedule and distance
additions.evidence: Fresh direct HTTP 200 content on 6 November gives every Saturday at 09:00, a free weekly 5 km around Norfolk Showground. The current body contains no coming-soon qualification; it supersedes the earlier indexed pre-launch wording. This regular schedule is not a guarantee against later cancellations.

additions.name: Native2Norfolk - Norfolk Food Hall launch context
additions.scope: Venue market partner parkrun launch context
additions.evidence: The market partner says the autumn market moved to 24 October 2026 to coincide with the parkrun launch; this supersedes the older 10 October market wording. Native2Norfolk is the market organiser, not the parkrun organiser. Use the primary Norfolk Food Hall programme for the running timetable.

additions.name: Norfolk Showground - venue address
additions.scope: Primary venue address reference
additions.evidence: The venue contact page identifies Norfolk Showground, Dereham Road, New Costessey, Norfolk, NR5 0TT. This is address context, not independent verification of a parkrun schedule, distance or launch date.

additions.name: Mole Valley District Council - Meadowbank junior parkrun
additions.scope: Council and event-director junior launch programme
additions.evidence: The council release dated 30 October 2026 gives the Meadowbank, Dorking launch as Sunday 22 November 2026 at 09:00, then weekly Sundays, 2 km, ages 4-14, meeting at the bandstand. It includes the event director. Direct retrieval succeeded after an earlier web retrieval error; a planned launch is retained as planned.

additions.name: Frome Town Council - Old Showfield parkrun context
additions.scope: Council park and existing adult parkrun reference
additions.evidence: The primary park page identifies the Old Showfield in Frome and the existing adult Saturday 09:00 parkrun. It does not establish the schedule or launch of the new junior event. Adult and junior programmes must remain separate.

additions.name: Visit Mid Devon - Impey Walk Knightshayes parkrun
additions.scope: Official council tourism parkrun venue and timetable
additions.evidence: The official tourism listing identifies a 5 km parkrun at the Knightshayes estate near Tiverton, Saturdays at 09:00, with arrival from 08:45. Arrival and start times are distinct. Separate inaugural-date evidence is required before calling a particular week the first event.

additions.name: Forestry England - Grizedale parkrun
additions.scope: Primary land manager parkrun programme and venue
additions.evidence: The primary land-manager page describes the new autumn 2026 Grizedale event, 5 km on Saturdays at 09:00, Hawkshead LA22 0QJ. The wider event inventory already contains the forestryengland.uk host under observed-host:5a7651846db5a23e1ad75d732b659ed9 for Bedgebury; that identity, unknown prior check date and collection status are preserved. This adds the missing disabled CSV reference, not another live provider.

additions.name: North West Leicestershire District Council - Coalville junior proposal
additions.scope: Council junior parkrun proposal and park context
additions.evidence: The June 2025 council material supports a weekly junior parkrun proposal in Coalville Park. Indexed council text was available; the inspected evidence does not give a confirmed 2026 launch or local start time. Do not create dated fixtures from this proposal alone.

additions.name: Rotterdam tourism - Zuiderpark parkrun
additions.scope: Official destination partner parkrun organiser programme
additions.evidence: Indexed organiser text gives Zuiderpark Rotterdam Saturday 09:00 starts and a 5 September 2026 launch, meeting by the canoe lake on Zuiderparkpromenade Oost. Direct web retrieval exposed only its iframe. The fully opened partner programme at https://www.uitagendarotterdam.nl/agenda/zuiderpark-parkrun/ separately confirms 5 km, the start and launch date. Do not confuse this venue with Zuiderpark Den Haag or Hoogeveen.

additions.name: Uitagenda Rotterdam - Zuiderpark parkrun programme
additions.scope: Official city cultural agenda hosting the organiser parkrun programme
additions.evidence: Opened organiser programme explicitly states weekly Saturday 09:00 starts, 5 km, and launch on 5 September 2026 at Zuiderpark Rotterdam by the canoe lake on Zuiderparkpromenade Oost. Current listing includes 7 November 2026. Its long repeating calendar is not proof that every future occurrence will proceed.

additions.name: Visit Haarlemmermeer - PARK21 parkrun
additions.scope: Municipal tourism partner current parkrun programme
additions.evidence: The opened municipal tourism page currently advertises 7 November 2026 and explicitly states every Saturday at 09:00, 5 km. The displayed 08:45-11:00 calendar window is an attendance window, not the start time. It links the official parkrun site and identifies Sportpark21. This is an active listing with no coming-soon wording; no exact inaugural date is established by this source.

additions.name: Güglingen council - Elsenzufer parkrun launch
additions.scope: Primary municipal announcement of a nearby parkrun launch and weekly programme
additions.evidence: The full council announcement dated 3 November 2026 was opened on 6 November. It gives the official Elsenzufer parkrun launch in Eppingen as Saturday 28 November 2026, 5 km at 09:00, with arrival at 08:45 and weekly Saturday operation. Earlier sessions are test runs, not official dated fixtures. The planned launch must remain distinct from a completed inaugural event.
